description: measure5-structural's self-checks 1-3 (dm-247) as main ran them: each record's touched files, selection, tiers, chunk timings and cut. With them, what test_selection.select reads of the tree at those commits: each test file's size (a record's sizes override them), and its import count with the hubs and changed modules among its imports. Per-test seconds come from a junit run of the suite.
